mapper.select: SELECT id, position, type, up_up_limit, up_limit, low_limit, lower_limit, unit, longitude, latitude, create_time, update_time FROM warning_indicator_setting WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT position, type FROM warning_indicator_setting WHERE position IS NOT NULL AND position != '' AND type IS NOT NULL AND type != '' ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT type FROM warning_indicator_setting ORDER BY type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warning_indicator_setting ( position, type, up_up_limit, up_limit, low_limit, lower_limit, unit, longitude, latitude, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{position}, #{type}, #{upUpLimit}, #{upLimit}, #{lowLimit}, #{lowerLimit}, #{unit}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
